"""Review computation (TASK-20260929-75e9e4, J2 attack (i)).

Extract the seven code blocks of the committed audit sheet by the PINNED method
(yaml.safe_load; code string unchanged; UTF-8; write) and, as a DISJOINT
second route, by a hand-written literal-block-scalar reader that does not use
PyYAML. Compare both byte strings, their sha256, the block's pinned
reference_sha256 and the TASK-20260929-36d781 receipt's extracted_sha256.
Reads committed bytes only (git show at the bound commit). Executes no block.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

import yaml

REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"
COMMIT = "3abef55308e7186c9363dccf8e0ed526f2dd6bc5"
SHEET = ("coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-361e02/design/"
         "TASK-20260929-291567/proof-search-map-audit.yaml")
RECEIPT = ("coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-361e02/archives/"
           "TASK-20260929-36d781/snapshot-receipt.json")
OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "impl")


def git_show(path):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", COMMIT + ":" + path],
                          check=True, capture_output=True).stdout


def manual_blocks(text):
    """Disjoint reader: find '      code: |' lines under code_blocks and take
    the literal block (clip chomping) by indentation, no YAML library."""
    lines = text.split("\n")
    out = {}
    cur_id = None
    i = 0
    in_blocks = False
    while i < len(lines):
        ln = lines[i]
        if ln.startswith("  code_blocks:"):
            in_blocks = True
        elif in_blocks and ln.startswith("  ") and not ln.startswith("   ") and ln.strip():
            in_blocks = False
        if in_blocks and ln.startswith("    - id: CODE-"):
            cur_id = ln.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        if in_blocks and ln.rstrip() == "      code: |":
            j = i + 1
            # indentation of the block = indentation of first non-empty line
            while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() == "":
                j += 1
            ind = len(lines[j]) - len(lines[j].lstrip(" "))
            body = []
            k = i + 1
            while k < len(lines):
                l2 = lines[k]
                if l2.strip() == "":
                    body.append("")
                    k += 1
                    continue
                if len(l2) - len(l2.lstrip(" ")) < ind:
                    break
                body.append(l2[ind:])
                k += 1
            while body and body[-1] == "":
                body.pop()  # clip chomping: drop trailing empty lines
            out[cur_id] = "\n".join(body) + "\n"
            i = k
            continue
        i += 1
    return out


def main():
    raw = git_show(SHEET)
    sheet_sha = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    receipt = json.loads(git_show(RECEIPT))
    doc = yaml.safe_load(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    blocks = doc["proof_search_map_audit"]["code_blocks"]
    manual = manual_blocks(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    report = {"sheet_sha256_at_commit": sheet_sha,
              "sheet_sha256_expected": receipt["path_sha256"][SHEET],
              "blocks": []}
    for b in blocks:
        code = b["code"]
        data = code.encode("utf-8")
        sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        mdata = manual.get(b["id"], "").encode("utf-8")
        msha = hashlib.sha256(mdata).hexdigest()
        rec = receipt["extracted_sha256"].get(b["id"], {})
        fname = os.path.join(OUT, b["file"])
        with open(fname, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(data)
        report["blocks"].append({
            "id": b["id"], "file": b["file"], "extract_as": b["extract_as"],
            "bytes": len(data), "lines": code.count("\n"),
            "ends_with_exactly_one_newline": code.endswith("\n") and not code.endswith("\n\n"),
            "sha256_pinned_method": sha,
            "sha256_disjoint_manual_reader": msha,
            "manual_equals_pinned_bytes": mdata == data,
            "reference_sha256_in_block": b.get("reference_sha256"),
            "receipt_extracted_sha256": rec.get("sha256"),
            "receipt_pinned_reference": rec.get("pinned_reference_sha256"),
            "match_reference": sha == b.get("reference_sha256"),
            "match_receipt": sha == rec.get("sha256"),
            "contains_exclamation": "!" in code,
            "keys_of_block": sorted(k for k in b.keys() if k != "code"),
        })
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Review computation, TASK-20260929-75e9e4, J1 (i) and J2 (R-6 order route).
Own code only; no producer module is imported.

(1) Brute-force point counts #E = 2 + 2 #{x != 0 : Tr(x + A + B/x^2) = 0} over
    my own F_2[t]/(f) arithmetic, vectorised with numpy: nonzero elements are
    enumerated as powers of a primitive element g (primitivity verified by a
    distinct-value count), x^-1 = g^(-i), Tr(B/x^2) = Tr(sqrt(B) x^-1) read as a
    linear functional. For Koblitz cells (A = 0, B = 1) the field polynomial is
    chosen by MY rule (largest-k irreducible trinomial, else a pentanomial);
    the ordinary cells use the contract's named polynomials because their A, B
    are integers in that basis.
(2) Route-B order proofs with my own affine binary-curve arithmetic
    (extended-Euclid inversion): a point P with N P = O and (N/p) P != O for
    every prime p | N, plus exactly one multiple of N in [q+1-2sqrt(q),
    q+1+2sqrt(q)]. Done for every declared curve cell including n = 41.
Cells: CELL-K13, CELL-K17C, CELL-K19, CELL-K23, CELL-K41, CELL-O19, CELL-RC1.
"""
import json
import math
import random
import time

import numpy as np
import sympy

T19 = (1 << 19) | (1 << 5) | (1 << 2) | (1 << 1) | 1
T17 = (1 << 17) | (1 << 3) | 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- field (own)
def pmod(a, f):
    df = f.bit_length() - 1
    while a.bit_length() - 1 >= df:
        a ^= f << (a.bit_length() - 1 - df)
    return a


def pmul(a, b, f):
    r = 0
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            r ^= a
        a <<= 1
        b >>= 1
    return pmod(r, f)


def pinv(a, f):
    """Extended Euclid over F_2[t]."""
    if a == 0:
        raise ZeroDivisionError
    r0, r1 = f, a
    s0, s1 = 0, 1
    while r1:
        # divide r0 by r1
        q = 0
        r = r0
        dr1 = r1.bit_length() - 1
        while r and r.bit_length() - 1 >= dr1:
            sh = r.bit_length() - 1 - dr1
            q ^= 1 << sh
            r ^= r1 << sh
        r0, r1 = r1, r
        # s update: s0 - q s1 (carry-less)
        qs = 0
        b, a2 = s1, q
        while a2:
            if a2 & 1:
                qs ^= b
            b <<= 1
            a2 >>= 1
        s0, s1 = s1, s0 ^ qs
    assert r0 == 1
    return pmod(s0, f)


def irreducible(f):
    """Rabin-type test: gcd(t^(2^i) - t, f) == 1 for i <= n/2 and t^(2^n) == t."""
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    x = 2
    cur = x
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        cur = pmul(cur, cur, f)
        if i <= n // 2:
            a, b = f, cur ^ x
            while b:
                # polynomial gcd
                db = b.bit_length() - 1
                while a and a.bit_length() - 1 >= db:
                    a ^= b << (a.bit_length() - 1 - db)
                a, b = b, a
            if a != 1:
                return False
    return cur == x


def my_poly(n):
    for k in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        f = (1 << n) | (1 << k) | 1
        if irreducible(f):
            return f
    for a in range(n - 1, 2, -1):
        for b in range(a - 1, 1, -1):
            for c in range(b - 1, 0, -1):
                f = (1 << n) | (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c) | 1
                if irreducible(f):
                    return f
    raise ValueError


def trace(a, f):
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    s, x = 0, a
    for _ in range(n):
        s ^= x
        x = pmul(x, x, f)
    assert s in (0, 1)
    return s


def fsqrt(a, f):
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    x = a
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        x = pmul(x, x, f)
    return x


def solve_quadratic(c, f):
    """z^2 + z = c, n odd, Tr(c) = 0: z = sum_{i=0}^{(n-1)/2} c^(2^(2i))."""
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    z, x = 0, c
    for _ in range((n - 1) // 2 + 1):
        z ^= x
        x = pmul(x, x, f)
        x = pmul(x, x, f)
    assert pmul(z, z, f) ^ z == c
    return z


# ------------------------------------------------------- brute-force count
def linear_map_cols(c, f):
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    return [pmul(c, 1 << j, f) for j in range(n)]


def apply_map(cols, arr):
    out = np.zeros_like(arr)
    for j, col in enumerate(cols):
        bit = (arr >> np.uint64(j)) & np.uint64(1)
        out ^= bit * np.uint64(col)
    return out


def all_powers(g, f):
    q1 = (1 << (f.bit_length() - 1)) - 1
    P = np.array([1], dtype=np.uint64)
    gk = g
    while len(P) < q1:
        nxt = apply_map(linear_map_cols(gk, f), P)
        P = np.concatenate([P, nxt])
        gk = pmul(gk, gk, f)
    return P[:q1]


def functional_mask(beta, f):
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    m = 0
    for j in range(n):
        if trace(pmul(beta, 1 << j, f), f):
            m |= 1 << j
    return m


def brute_count(f, A, B):
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    q1 = (1 << n) - 1
    g = 2
    P = all_powers(g, f)
    distinct = int(np.unique(P).size)
    if distinct != q1:
        for g in range(3, 64):
            P = all_powers(g, f)
            distinct = int(np.unique(P).size)
            if distinct == q1:
                break
    assert distinct == q1, "no primitive element found"
    tmask = np.uint64(functional_mask(1, f))
    beta = fsqrt(B, f)
    bmask = np.uint64(functional_mask(beta, f))
    trA = trace(A, f)
    tr_x = (np.bitwise_count(P & tmask) & np.uint8(1)).astype(np.int8)
    lb = (np.bitwise_count(P & bmask) & np.uint8(1)).astype(np.int8)
    idx = (-np.arange(q1, dtype=np.int64)) % q1
    lb_inv = lb[idx]  # L_beta(x^-1) with x = g^i, x^-1 = g^-i
    good = int(np.count_nonzero((tr_x ^ lb_inv ^ trA) == 0))
    return 2 + 2 * good, g, distinct


# ------------------------------------------------------ curve arithmetic (own)
def ec_add(P, Q, A, f):
    if P is None:
        return Q
    if Q is None:
        return P
    x1, y1 = P
    x2, y2 = Q
    if x1 == x2:
        if y2 == x1 ^ y1:
            return None
        if x1 == 0:
            return None
        lam = x1 ^ pmul(y1, pinv(x1, f), f)
        x3 = pmul(lam, lam, f) ^ lam ^ A
        y3 = pmul(x1, x1, f) ^ pmul(lam ^ 1, x3, f)
        return (x3, y3)
    lam = pmul(y1 ^ y2, pinv(x1 ^ x2, f), f)
    x3 = pmul(lam, lam, f) ^ lam ^ x1 ^ x2 ^ A
    y3 = pmul(lam, x1 ^ x3, f) ^ x3 ^ y1
    return (x3, y3)


def ec_mul(k, P, A, f):
    R = None
    Q = P
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            R = ec_add(R, Q, A, f)
        Q = ec_add(Q, Q, A, f)
        k >>= 1
    return R


def on_curve(P, A, B, f):
    x, y = P
    return pmul(y, y, f) ^ pmul(x, y, f) == pmul(pmul(x, x, f), x, f) ^ pmul(A, pmul(x, x, f), f) ^ B


def random_point(rng, A, B, f):
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    while True:
        x = rng.randrange(1, 1 << n)
        c = x ^ A ^ pmul(B, pinv(pmul(x, x, f), f), f)
        if trace(c, f) == 0:
            z = solve_quadratic(c, f)
            P = (x, pmul(x, z, f))
            assert on_curve(P, A, B, f)
            return P


def route_B(N, A, B, f, rng, tries=64):
    n = f.bit_length() - 1
    primes = sorted(sympy.factorint(N))
    for t in range(tries):
        P = random_point(rng, A, B, f)
        if ec_mul(N, P, A, f) is not None:
            return {"proved": False, "why": "N does not annihilate a point"}
        if all(ec_mul(N // p, P, A, f) is not None for p in primes):
            q = 1 << n
            lo = q + 1 - 2 * math.isqrt(q) - 2
            hi = q + 1 + 2 * math.isqrt(q) + 2
            mult = [k * N for k in range(max(1, lo // N), hi // N + 2) if lo <= k * N <= hi]
            return {"proved": len(mult) == 1, "point_of_order_N_found_at_try": t,
                    "primes_of_N": [str(p) for p in primes],
                    "multiples_of_N_in_hasse_window": [str(m) for m in mult]}
    return {"proved": False, "why": "no point of order N within tries"}


CELLS = [
    ("CELL-K13", 13, 0, 1, None, 8012),
    ("CELL-K17C", 17, 0, 1, None, 130972),
    ("CELL-K19", 19, 0, 1, None, 523492),
    ("CELL-K23", 23, 0, 1, None, 8383412),
    ("CELL-K41", 41, 0, 1, None, 2199025563772),
    ("CELL-O19", 19, 46693, 306147, T19, 523646),
    ("CELL-RC1", 17, 97044, 126251, T17, 130412),
]


def main():
    out = {"numpy": np.__version__, "sympy": sympy.__version__, "cells": []}
    for cid, n, A, B, fixed, design in CELLS:
        f = fixed if fixed is not None else my_poly(n)
        rec = {"cell": cid, "n": n, "A": A, "B": B, "field_poly": bin(f),
               "field_poly_rule": "contract-named (A, B are in that basis)" if fixed else "my rule: largest-k irreducible trinomial, else pentanomial",
               "irreducible_own_test": irreducible(f), "design_time_order": design}
        t0 = time.time()
        if n <= 23:
            cnt, g, distinct = brute_count(f, A, B)
            rec["brute_force_order"] = cnt
            rec["primitive_element_used"] = g
            rec["brute_force_matches_design"] = cnt == design
            rec["brute_force_seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
        N = design
        rec["factorisation_of_design_order"] = {str(p): e for p, e in sorted(sympy.factorint(N).items())}
        rng = random.Random(1000 + n + A)
        rb = route_B(N, A, B, f, rng)
        rec["route_B_on_design_order"] = rb
        v, odd = 0, N
        while odd % 2 == 0:
            odd //= 2
            v += 1
        rec["cofactor"] = 1 << v
        out["cells"].append(rec)
        print(cid, rec.get("brute_force_order"), rb.get("proved"), flush=True)
    json.dump(out, open("out_j1_counts.json", "w"), indent=1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Review computation, TASK-20260929-75e9e4, J1 attacks (ii), (iii), (iv) and the
R-12 arithmetic. Own code (mpmath at 50 digits); no producer module imported.
Frozen values are parsed from the COMMITTED audit sheet bytes (git show at
3abef55308) and compared entry by entry.

Recomputes: log2 l, matched rho, the ideal-tree ceiling table (target-subgroup
ambient), the gap and closure lines in BOTH ambients, the HEUR-B2 threshold
arithmetic (ambient check only; the heuristic itself is J3's), rule R-M
alphabets under both N readings, rule R-S sample sizes, S/M^2, the 100 x M^2
comparison, the per-cell totals, DC-B1, the (C3) and (C4) floors in both
ambients, and the certificate divisor sets (sympy.divisors, an independent
library path from CODE-CERT).
"""
import json
import subprocess

import mpmath as mp
import sympy
import yaml

mp.mp.dps = 50
REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"
COMMIT = "3abef55308e7186c9363dccf8e0ed526f2dd6bc5"
SHEET = ("coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-361e02/design/"
         "TASK-20260929-291567/proof-search-map-audit.yaml")
L = 680564733841876926932320129493409985129


def load():
    raw = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", COMMIT + ":" + SHEET],
                         check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
    return yaml.safe_load(raw.decode("utf-8"))["proof_search_map_audit"]


def lg(x):
    return mp.log(mp.mpf(x), 2)


def f(x, nd=6):
    return float(mp.nstr(x, 15)) if not isinstance(x, float) else x


def main():
    s = load()["stage_0"]
    out = {"mpmath": mp.__version__, "sympy": sympy.__version__, "checks": []}

    def chk(name, mine, frozen, tol):
        mine_f = float(mine)
        d = abs(mine_f - float(frozen))
        out["checks"].append({"quantity": name, "recomputed": round(mine_f, 6),
                              "frozen": frozen, "abs_diff": round(d, 6),
                              "tolerance": tol, "within": d <= tol})

    LOG2L = lg(L)
    LOG2_4L = lg(4 * L)
    RHO = mp.mpf(1) / 2 * lg(mp.pi * L / (4 * 131))
    L262 = lg(262)
    L17 = lg(17)
    out["log2_l"] = mp.nstr(LOG2L, 25)
    out["log2_4l"] = mp.nstr(LOG2_4L, 25)
    out["rho"] = mp.nstr(RHO, 20)
    pin = s["pinned_inputs"]
    chk("log2_l", LOG2L, 129.0000, 5e-5)
    chk("rho", RHO, float(str(pin["rho"]).split("=")[0].strip().replace("2^", "")), 5e-5)
    chk("log2_262", L262, float(pin["log2_262"].split()[0]), 5e-5)
    chk("log2_17", L17, float(pin["log2_17"].split()[0]), 5e-5)

    # ---- ceiling table, target-subgroup ambient (N = l)
    for row in s["ideal_tree_table"]["rows"]:
        k, j = row["k"], row["j"]
        lL = LOG2L / (j + 1)
        per = lL + j
        chk("k%d log2_L" % k, lL, row["log2_L"], 5e-5)
        chk("k%d log2_per_attempt" % k, per, row["log2_per_attempt"], 5e-5)
        for orb in ("without_orbit", "with_orbit"):
            rel = lL - (L262 if orb == "with_orbit" else 0)
            main = rel + per
            la = j + 2 * rel
            tot = main + lg(1 + mp.mpf(2) ** (la - main))
            fr = row[orb]
            chk("k%d %s relations" % (k, orb), rel, fr["log2_relations"], 5e-5)
            chk("k%d %s main" % (k, orb), main, fr["log2_main_term"], 5e-5)
            chk("k%d %s linear_algebra" % (k, orb), la, fr["log2_linear_algebra"], 5e-5)
            chk("k%d %s total" % (k, orb), tot, fr["log2_total"], 5e-5)
            chk("k%d %s margin" % (k, orb), tot - RHO, fr["ceiling_margin_against_rho_bits"], 1e-4)
            if (tot - RHO) < 0:
                out["checks"].append({"quantity": "k%d %s below-rho row carries margin_reading" % (k, orb),
                                      "within": "margin_reading" in fr})
        chk("k%d memory" % k, j + lL + L17, row["log2_memory_bytes"], 5e-5)

    # ---- gap and closure, both ambients
    gc = s["ideal_tree_table"]["gap_and_closure_both_ambients"]
    for amb, log2n, cap in (("target_subgroup_ambient", LOG2L, 0), ("full_group_ambient", LOG2_4L, 2)):
        for row in gc[amb]["rows"]:
            k = row["k"]
            j = k.bit_length() - 1
            lL = log2n / (j + 1)
            gap = lL - cap
            per = lL + j
            clos = per + (j - 1) * gap
            chk("%s k%d needed" % (amb, k), lL, row["needed_bits"], 5e-5)
            chk("%s k%d capacity" % (amb, k), cap, row["capacity_bits"], 0)
            chk("%s k%d gap" % (amb, k), gap, row["gap_bits"], 5e-5)
            chk("%s k%d per_attempt" % (amb, k), per, row["log2_per_attempt"], 5e-5)
            chk("%s k%d closure" % (amb, k), clos, row["closure_log2"], 5e-5)
    # the withdrawn mixed-ambient v1 figures, for the record
    j = 4
    out["v1_mixed_k16_gap"] = float(LOG2L / 5 - 2)
    out["v1_mixed_k16_closure"] = float(LOG2L / 5 + 4 + 3 * (LOG2L / 5 - 2))

    # ---- HEUR-B2 threshold arithmetic (declared ambient N = l)
    for row in s["heur_b2_thresholds"]["rows"]:
        k = row["k"]
        j = k.bit_length() - 1
        lL = LOG2L / (j + 1)
        rel = lL - (L262 if row["orbit"] == "with" else 0)
        main = rel + lL + j
        la = j + 2 * rel
        tot = main + lg(1 + mp.mpf(2) ** (la - main))
        if tot >= RHO:
            g = lL
            binding = False
        else:
            # solve 2^(main + (j-1)(lL - g)) + 2^la = 2^rho for g
            need = RHO + lg(1 - mp.mpf(2) ** (la - RHO))
            g = lL - (need - main) / (j - 1)
            binding = True
        chk("heurb2 k%d %s g*" % (k, row["orbit"]), g, row["g_star_bits"], 5e-5)
        chk("heurb2 k%d %s c" % (k, row["orbit"]), g / LOG2L, row["c"], 5e-5)

"""Review computation, TASK-20260929-75e9e4, J1 R-12 corroboration (optional).
The contract does NOT prove l prime; it rests the divisor set of 4l on the
primary source's statement (a disclosed condition). This script attempts an
independent Pocklington-Lehmer certificate for l as extra corroboration only.
Pure integer arithmetic; no curve is instantiated. Own code plus
sympy.factorint for factoring l - 1.

Pocklington: if l - 1 = F R with F > sqrt(l), every prime q | F known, and for
each such q some a with a^(l-1) = 1 (mod l) and gcd(a^((l-1)/q) - 1, l) = 1,
then l is prime. Each prime factor q of F is itself certified: by complete
trial division when q < 2^40, or recursively by the same test.
"""
import json
import math
import signal
import time

import sympy

L = 680564733841876926932320129493409985129


class TO(Exception):
    pass


def handler(signum, frame):
    raise TO()


def trial_prime(q):
    if q < 2:
        return False
    if q % 2 == 0:
        return q == 2
    r = math.isqrt(q)
    d = 3
    while d <= r:
        if q % d == 0:
            return False
        d += 2
    return True


def pocklington(n, depth=0, log=None):
    if log is None:
        log = []
    if n < (1 << 40):
        ok = trial_prime(n)
        log.append({"n": str(n), "method": "complete trial division", "prime": ok, "depth": depth})
        return ok, log
    fac = sympy.factorint(n - 1)
    # choose F: product of all found prime powers (full factorisation)
    F = 1
    for q, e in fac.items():
        F *= q ** e
    assert F == n - 1
    entry = {"n": str(n), "depth": depth, "n_minus_1_factors": {str(q): e for q, e in sorted(fac.items())},
             "witnesses": {}}
    for q in sorted(fac):
        found = None
        for a in range(2, 200):
            if pow(a, n - 1, n) != 1:
                entry["fermat_fails_for"] = a
                entry["prime"] = False
                log.append(entry)
                return False, log
            if math.gcd(pow(a, (n - 1) // q, n) - 1, n) == 1:
                found = a
                break
        if found is None:
            entry["prime"] = False
            entry["no_witness_for"] = str(q)
            log.append(entry)
            return False, log
        entry["witnesses"][str(q)] = found
    log.append(entry)
    for q in sorted(fac):
        ok, log = pocklington(q, depth + 1, log)
        if not ok:
            return False, log
    entry["prime"] = True
    return True, log


def main():
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, handler)
    signal.alarm(600)
    t0 = time.time()
    out = {"l": str(L), "bits": L.bit_length(), "sympy": sympy.__version__}
    try:
        ok, log = pocklington(L)
        out["proved_prime"] = ok
        out["certificate"] = log
    except TO:
        out["proved_prime"] = None
        out["note"] = "timed out after 600 s; not computed"
    out["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
    out["sympy_isprime_BPSW"] = sympy.isprime(L)
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import collections
import hashlib
import json
import os

class SynthZ:
    """Z/NZ, non-identity uniform sampling, identity sums redrawn (None)."""

    def __init__(self, cid, N):
        self.id, self.N = cid, N

    def sample(self, rng):
        return rng.randrange(1, self.N)

    def add(self, i, j):
        s = (i + j) % self.N
        return None if s == 0 else s

    def key(self, i):
        return i

    def unpack(self, k):
        return k


def my_gain(stream, S, lab, M, min_cell=100):
    tab = collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
    pid = stream.pid
    for k in range(S):
        a, b, c = lab[pid[3 * k]], lab[pid[3 * k + 1]], lab[pid[3 * k + 2]]
        tab[(a, b)][c] += 1
    best, used, excl, mass, pm = 0.0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    for ab, ctr in tab.items():
        nab = sum(ctr.values())
        if nab < min_cell:
            excl += 1
            continue
        used += 1
        mass += nab
        top = max(ctr.values())
        if top == nab:
            pm += 1
        best = max(best, top / nab)
    return {"G": M * best, "used": used, "excluded": excl,
            "empty": M * M - len(tab), "used_mass": mass, "point_mass_used": pm}


def exact(g, M):
    return g["G"] == M and g["point_mass_used"] == g["used"]


def occupied(g, M):
    return g["used"] >= (M * M) // 2 and g["excluded"] <= g["used"]


def run_exact(N, M, tag, seeds=range(10), crosscheck=False, strata_mod=None):
    """Exact filter i mod M on Z/N (M | N) at S = S_of(M)."""

            q = strata_mod

        if crosscheck:
            mg = my_gain(stream, S, lab, M)
            eg = rd["direct"]
            xc.append({k: (mg[k], eg[k]) for k in ("G", "used", "excluded", "empty", "used_mass", "point_mass_used")})
            s_lab = est.shuffled(lab, U, est.seed_of("sh", cell.id, "exact", M, s, 0), strata)
            same_hist = collections.Counter(s_lab) == collections.Counter(lab[0:U])

                    == collections.Counter(lab[i] for i in range(U) if strata[i] == e) for e in range(q))
            moved = sum(1 for i in range(U) if s_lab[i] != lab[i])

                       "shuffled_fields_equal": all(mg2[k] == eg2[k] for k in mg2)})

            "all_occupied": all(p["occupied"] for p in per_seed),
            "PC6a_shuffle_median_le_q99_every_seed": pc6a,
            "shuffle_median_within_W_of_q50_every_seed": within_w,
            "max_shuffle_median": max(p["shuffle_median"] for p in per_seed),
            "per_seed": per_seed, "crosscheck": xc,

def run_planted(N, M, tag, seeds=range(10), crosscheck=False, f5=False):
    """Planted marginal-only filter (CODE-EST planted_marginal_labels), or with

        else:

and checks: every experiment and hypothesis template field
(templates/research-records.md), every approval field, the supersedes fields,
runs_launched, the pass-criteria to rules mapping (SR-1 and IR text), and
whether every pass criterion id appears in the code blocks. Also git custody of
the absorbed and cited proposal records and of experiments/EXP-BINSTD-6f1e66/.
"""
import json
import re
import subprocess

import yaml

REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"
C = "3abef55308e7186c9363dccf8e0ed526f2dd6bc5"
HYP = "ledger/hypotheses/H-BINSTD-de2808.yaml"

         "TASK-20260929-291567/proof-search-map-audit.yaml")

                "controls", "independent_variables", "metrics", "heuristic_under_test",
                "preregistered_prediction", "scale_relevance", "tail_checks", "replication",
                "budget", "stopping_rules", "invalidation_rules", "success_criterion",
                "falsification_criterion", "required_artifacts", "assigned_to", "approved_by"]
HYP_TEMPLATE = ["id", "question_id", "statement", "mechanism", "assumptions", "proof_search_map",
                "rerandomization", "asymptotic_claim", "heuristic_assumptions",
                "structural_ingredients", "reduction_chain", "predictions", "test_boundary",
                "falsification_conditions", "interpretation_limits", "status", "proposed_by"]
HEUR_FIELDS = ["id", "formal_statement", "random_model_justification", "supporting_results",
               "validation_experiment_ids", "falsification_condition"]


def show(path, commit=C):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", commit + ":" + path],
                          check=True, capture_output=True).stdout.decode("utf-8")


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO] + list(args), check=True,
                          capture_output=True).stdout.decode("utf-8")


def main():
    hyp = yaml.safe_load(show(HYP))["hypothesis"]
    spec = yaml.safe_load(show(SPEC))["experiment"]
    sheet = yaml.safe_load(show(SHEET))["proof_search_map_audit"]
    out = {}
    out["experiment_template_fields_missing"] = [k for k in EXP_TEMPLATE if k not in spec]
    out["experiment_template_fields_present"] = len([k for k in EXP_TEMPLATE if k in spec])
    out["experiment_budget_subfields"] = {k: spec["budget"].get(k, "MISSING") for k in
                                          ("enforcement", "wall_clock_seconds_per_run", "total_cpu_hours",
                                           "maximum_memory_gb", "maximum_runs", "maximum_workers")}

                          "has_validation_plan": "validation_plan" in h,
                          "supporting_results_provenance": [(r["ref"][:60], r["provenance"], r.get("verified_by") is not None) for r in h["supporting_results"]]}
                         for h in hyp["heuristic_assumptions"]]
    out["structural_ingredients_provenance"] = [(s["citation"][:60] if isinstance(s["citation"], str) else s["citation"], s["provenance"], bool(s.get("verified_by"))) for s in hyp["structural_ingredients"]]
    out["approval"] = {
        "spec.status": spec["status"], "spec.approved_by": spec["approved_by"],
        "spec.approval": spec.get("approval"),
        "spec.review_required": spec.get("review_required"),
        "spec.runs_launched": spec.get("runs_launched"),
        "spec.assigned_to": spec.get("assigned_to"),
        "spec.inference_for_execution": spec.get("inference_for_execution"),
        "hyp.status": hyp["status"], "hyp.approved_by": hyp.get("approved_by"),
        "hyp.composing_decision": hyp.get("composing_decision"),
        "hyp.runs_launched": hyp.get("runs_launched"),
        "sheet.runs_launched": sheet.get("runs_launched"),

    out["supersedes"] = {"hyp": hyp.get("supersedes"), "spec": spec.get("supersedes"),
                         "sheet": sheet.get("supersedes"), "sheet_audit": sheet.get("supersedes_audit"),
                         "hyp_record_kind": hyp.get("record_kind"), "spec_record_kind": spec.get("record_kind"),
                         "hyp_note_cites_9d9c47": "DEC-20260928-9d9c47" in hyp.get("supersession_note", ""),
                         "spec_note_cites_9d9c47": "DEC-20260928-9d9c47" in spec.get("supersession_note", "")}
    # pass criteria ids vs rules and code

    for grp in ("run_level", "per_cell", "stage_2_validity"):
        for pc in sheet["pass_criteria_stated_before_execution"][grp]:
            pcs.append(pc["id"])
    rules = " ".join(spec["stopping_rules"]) + " " + " ".join(spec["invalidation_rules"])
    code = " ".join(b["code"] for b in sheet["code_blocks"])
    out["pass_criteria"] = [{"id": p, "in_SR_or_IR": p in rules, "named_in_code": p in code} for p in pcs]
    # code blocks vs what the text says is coded
    out["code_block_ids"] = [b["id"] for b in sheet["code_blocks"]]
    out["code_has_heur_b1_function"] = bool(re.search(r"heur|chi|binom", code, re.I))
    out["missing_instruments_text"] = spec["inputs"].get("missing_instruments")
    out["cost_table_advisory_ceilings"] = sheet["stage_0"]["cost_table"]["advisory_ceilings"]
    out["spec_budget_maximum_runs"] = spec["budget"]["maximum_runs"]
    out["hyp_test_boundary_budget"] = hyp["test_boundary"]["budget"]

             "ledger/proposals/IDEA-20260922-153a90.yaml", "ledger/proposals/IDEA-20260922-faa8d2.yaml",
             "ledger/proposals/IDEA-20260922-845a77.yaml", "ledger/proposals/IDEA-20260926-d3c5a5.yaml"]
    cust = {}
    for p in cited:
        log = git("log", "--format=%h %ad %s", "--date=iso", "--", p).strip().splitlines()
        cust[p] = {"commits": len(log), "last": log[0] if log else None,
                   "touched_by_3abef55308": p in git("show", "--name-only", "--format=", C)}
    out["cited_record_custody"] = cust
    out["snapshot_commit_files"] = git("show", "--name-only", "--format=", C).split()
    out["experiment_dir_tree_at_HEAD"] = git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "HEAD", "experiments/EXP-BINSTD-6f1e66/").split()
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=str))

    main()
